privacy_s1_p1: Each local congregation using Unitae is the data controller for its own data within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy_s1_p2: MindsersIT, publisher of the hosted platform unitae.app, acts as a data processor in accordance with Article 28 of the GDPR. A Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is established between MindsersIT and each client congregation.
privacy_s1_p2_instance_named: This instance is run by {operator}, which hosts and administers it. Unitae being free software (AGPL-3.0), its publisher has no access to its data.
privacy_s1_p2_instance: This instance is hosted and administered by the entity that deployed it. Unitae being free software (AGPL-3.0), its publisher has no access to its data.
privacy_s2_intro: Unitae collects and processes the following categories of personal data:
privacy_s2_identification_details: last name, first name, email address
privacy_s2_religious_details: baptism date, publisher status, congregation responsibilities (elder, ministerial servant, anointed), service activities, date of arrival in the congregation, date of the last pastoral visit
privacy_s2_activity_details: monthly field service reports, territory assignments
privacy_s2_technical_details: IP address (for consent records), session data
privacy_s3_p1: The mere presence of a user in Unitae reveals their religious affiliation as a Jehovah's Witness. This data constitutes special category data within the meaning of Article 9 of the GDPR.
privacy_s3_p2: Processing is based on Article 9(2)(d): processing carried out in the course of legitimate activities by a not-for-profit body with a religious aim, on condition that the processing relates solely to the members of that body and that the data is not disclosed outside of it without the consent of the data subjects.
privacy_s4_contract_details: provision of the congregation management service
privacy_s5_purpose_1: Management of congregation members and responsibilities
privacy_s6_users: User accounts: duration of membership + 30 days
privacy_s6_activity: Field service reports: duration of membership (configurable by congregation)
privacy_s6_attributions: Territory assignments: duration of the congregation account
privacy_s6_documents: Information board documents: until deleted by administrator + 30 days
privacy_s7_intro: Data is processed by the following sub-processors:
privacy_s7_google_service: Address search and maps in territory PDFs
privacy_s7_transfers: Transfers to the United States are governed by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) or standard contractual clauses.
privacy_s7_instance: The operator of this instance chooses its hosting and its providers (email delivery, maps).
privacy_s7_instance_ask_contact: It gives you the list on request:
privacy_s7_instance_ask: It gives you the list on request, through your congregation's administrator.
privacy_s8_intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy_s8_access_details: obtain a copy of your personal data
privacy_s8_erasure_details: request the deletion of your data
privacy_s8_portability_details: receive your data in a structured format
privacy_s8_restriction_details: restrict the processing of your data
privacy_s8_withdraw_details: withdraw your consent at any time
privacy_s8_exercise: To exercise these rights, contact your local congregation's administrator. For the hosted platform unitae.app, you may also contact MindsersIT at: privacy@mindsers.it
privacy_s8_exercise_instance: To exercise these rights, contact your local congregation's administrator.
privacy_s8_exercise_instance_contact: You may also write to the operator of this instance:
privacy_s9_intro: Unitae implements the following security measures:
privacy_s10_p1: Unitae sets three cookies, all strictly necessary and needing no consent: the session cookie, to stay signed in; the interface language; and whether the sidebar is open or folded.
privacy_s10_p1b: Other display preferences (light or dark theme, map display) stay in your browser and are never sent.
privacy_s10_p2: The maps shown on screen come from this instance: they set no cookies and call no third-party service.
privacy_s11_text: If you believe that the processing of your personal data constitutes a violation of the GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés (CNIL) — www.cnil.fr.
privacy_s12_text: Unitae is open-source software (AGPL-3.0). Self-hosted instances are the sole responsibility of the entity deploying them. MindsersIT has no role as a data processor in this case, as no data passes through its systems.

external_speakers_contact_help: At least a phone or an email, two of each at most, as on the lists received.
external_speakers_field_talks_help: The outline numbers he can give, as the list received gives them.
external_speakers_restored_toast: Speaker put back on the list.
external_speakers_retire_body: He will no longer be offered in programmes. His visits stay in the history, and he comes back in one click from « Removed ».
external_speakers_retire_planned: He is planned on {date}: he stays there, flagged « no longer on the list ».
external_speakers_delete_body: His record, contact details and talks disappear. This cannot be undone.
external_speakers_delete_freed_one: 1 planned talk is freed: {dates}. The part goes back to « to fill ».
external_speakers_delete_freed_many: {count} planned talks are freed: {dates}. The parts go back to « to fill ».
external_speakers_delete_past_one: His past visit stays in the programmes as « {label} », without his name.
external_speakers_delete_past_many: His {count} past visits stay in the programmes as « {label} », without his name.
external_speakers_contact_missing: To complete: usually at the top of the list received.
external_speakers_update_list_desktop: Updating a list is done on a computer or tablet.
external_speakers_congregation_contacts_: Optional: importing their list fills them in. The coordinator’s email will be used to send him our list.
external_speakers_congregation_delete_bo: It has no speaker left. Its contacts and the PDF of its latest list disappear.
external_speakers_congregation_new_descr: A congregation whose list of speakers you receive.
external_speakers_none_on_list: No speaker yet: update a congregation’s list, or add a speaker.
external_speakers_update_intro: Import the PDF {name} just sent: its lines are read and compared with the current list. Check them beside the PDF and correct if needed. Nothing is saved before « Save ».
external_speakers_update_drop_title: Drop the PDF you received here
external_speakers_update_drop_body: Table or plain list: names, phones, emails, talk numbers and the congregation’s contacts are picked out.
external_speakers_update_no_pdf: No PDF, or a single correction? Edit the rows below.
external_speakers_update_scanned: This PDF is an image (a scan or a photo): no line could be read. Correct the list by hand with the PDF beside it; it will be kept on the congregation’s record.
external_speakers_update_unreadable: This file does not open as a PDF.
external_speakers_update_note_retired: Missing from the new PDF. His visits stay in the history; if he is already planned, he stays there, flagged.
external_speakers_update_note_returning: Removed until now: he comes back on the list.
external_speakers_update_note_elsewhere: A {name} is on {congregation}’s list. The same brother?
external_speakers_update_note_moving: He leaves {congregation}’s list; his visits and talks follow him.
external_speakers_update_why: Two phones and two emails at most per speaker, as on the lists received. A speaker missing from the new PDF is proposed « Removed »: he keeps his history. A name already known in another congregation is proposed as the same brother, to keep his visits.
external_speakers_update_pdf_kept: Kept on {name}’s record when saved; it replaces the previous one.
external_speakers_update_answer_first: Answer « the same brother? » before saving.
external_speakers_update_file_invalid: This file is not a PDF.
external_speakers_update_stale: The list changed in the meantime: reload the page and start again.
settings_external_speakers_subtitle: Our list of speakers: who may be on it, and who is in charge of it.
settings_external_speakers_section_hint: What we send to other congregations.
settings_external_speakers_candidates_hi: An organigram role. Its members may be put on our list; then you tick who goes on it.
settings_external_speakers_responsible_h: The role the congregation created for this task. Its holder is printed at the top of our list, and replies to what we send go to him.
settings_external_speakers_coordinator_m: Nobody holds the coordinator post in the organigram.
external_speakers_ours_no_role_title: Our list is not set up yet
external_speakers_ours_no_role: Choose in Settings the organigram role that gathers your public speakers: its members become the candidates, and you tick those who go on our list.
external_speakers_ours_no_role_reader: An administrator chooses in Settings the organigram role that gathers your public speakers.
external_speakers_ours_no_candidates: The {role} role has no members yet: add them from the organigram.
external_speakers_ours_group_off_hint: open a brother and tick « On our list »
external_speakers_ours_empty_on: Nobody on our list: open a candidate and tick « On our list ».
external_speakers_ours_why: Only the brothers ticked « On our list » go in the PDF. The shared contact follows his record by default and can be replaced: another number, an address for talks, up to two phones and two emails.
external_speakers_ours_header_title: At the top of the list
external_speakers_ours_header_hint: Printed at the top of the PDF, before the speakers.
external_speakers_ours_sends_hint: Where our list went, and when.
external_speakers_ours_marked_up_to_date: Marked sent on {date} · up to date
external_speakers_ours_no_recipients: No congregation yet: they come from the lists received.
external_speakers_ours_on_list_hint: Unticked, he stays a candidate but is not in the PDF.
external_speakers_ours_talks_hint: The outline numbers he prepares for other congregations.
external_speakers_ours_contact_hint: « From his record » follows his record when it changes.
external_speakers_ours_not_candidate: This brother is no longer in the candidates’ role.
external_speakers_send_description: One email per congregation: none sees the others’ addresses.
external_speakers_send_from_hint: The app sends from its own address, not from your mailbox.
external_speakers_send_reply_to_hint: Our public talk coordinator: replies reach him directly.
external_speakers_send_reply_to_missing: Nobody: choose the public talk coordinator in Settings.
external_speakers_send_to: To — each congregation’s public talk coordinator
external_speakers_send_subject_default: List of speakers of the {name} congregation — {month}
external_speakers_send_message_default:
Hello,

Here is the up-to-date list of speakers of the {name} congregation, attached.

Kind regards,
{signature}
external_speakers_send_attachment: {count} speakers, headed by the coordinator and the public talk coordinator
external_speakers_send_unavailable: This installation does not send emails. Download the PDF, send it from your mailbox, then mark it sent to keep track.
external_speakers_send_partial: Sent to {sent}; could not go to {names}.
external_speakers_send_failed: Our list could not go to any congregation. Download the PDF to send it yourself.
external_speakers_mark_description: For a list sent from your mailbox: « sent on … » stays right.
external_speakers_mark_done_one: Our list is marked sent to 1 congregation.
external_speakers_mark_done_many: Our list is marked sent to {count} congregations.
settings_external_speakers_role_gone: This role no longer exists: choose another one.
external_speakers_ours_error_phone: Enter the number to share, or choose « From his record ».
external_speakers_ours_error_email: Enter the address to share, or choose « From his record ».
external_speakers_ours_candidates_count: Candidates: the {count} brothers of the {role} organigram role. {on} are on our list.
external_speakers_send_no_reply_to: Without a public talk coordinator, replies would go to the app’s address, which nobody reads.
settings_map_tiles_missing: No base map on this instance
settings_map_tiles_missing_description: On-screen maps are hidden. Your host can add one, cut to the congregation’s area: give them this file.
settings_map_tiles_no_area: No area yet: place buildings, or import the congregation’s perimeter in Congregation map.
settings_map_tiles_docs: How to add a base map
